root.label: Planned Parenthood Votes launches We Decide ad campaign

events.label: Planned Parenthood Votes launches We Decide ad campaign

slots.name: campaign budget
slots.sentence: Planned Parenthood Votes unveiled its $47 million “We Decide” ad campaign over the summer, intended to unseat lawmakers whom the super PAC claim voted to defund Planned Parenthood — which provides reproductive healthcare, including abortion procedures.
